newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moonstone sees Jan diamond production.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moonstone sees Jan diamond production.

text.p: Moonstone Diamond Corp NL said on Friday that it expects to start full-scale diamond mining operations off the west coast of South Africa in January.

The company said an 87-metre diamond mining vessel, the Moonstar, christened on Thursday, would mine for gems at a targeted rate of 65,000 carats a year on a joint venture basis with Benguela Concessions Ltd.
Mining will be conducted on Benguela's 2(b) and 3(b) marine concessions near the mouth of the Orange River, Moonstone said.
Initial work on less than seven percent of the total area of the concessions has returned an indicated and inferred resource of about 345,000 carats, Moonstone said.

Moonstone said it expected the value of the diamonds to be about US$200 a carat, with the venture grossing over US$10 million a year. Annual operation costs are estimated at between US$4 million and US$4.4 million.

By providing US$10 million to acquire and refurbish the Moonstar, Moonstone will receive a 7.5 percent royalty above its 50 percent entitlement, decreasing to 2.5 percent once the cpaital cost is repaid, the company said.
